# FozPrints

> Premium 3D Printed Subaru Forester Parts & Accessories

FozPrints designs and manufactures engineering-grade, heat-resistant (ASA up to 95°C) 3D printed interior pods, mounts, and accessories specifically for the SG Subaru Forester (2003–2008). Built and tested in Australia.

## Core Products

- [Subaru Forester SG Double DIN Nav Pod Kit (2003 to 2008, USDM spec)](https://fozprints.com.au/products/subaru-forester-sg-double-din-nav-pod-kit-20032008-usdm-spec): Converts the top dashboard pocket into a double DIN head unit navigation pod.
- [Double DIN Lower Storage Cubby](https://fozprints.com.au/products/subaru-forester-sg-2003-2008-double-din-lower-storage-cubby): Replacement storage tray with an OEM-style dashboard texture finish.
- [Rooftop Tent Anderson Plug Holder](https://fozprints.com.au/products/rooftop-tent-anderson-plug-holder-t-slot-power-mount): Heavy-duty T-slot power mount.
- [Rooftop Tent Cable Organiser](https://fozprints.com.au/products/rooftop-tent-cable-organiser-t-slot-wire-router): T-slot wire routing mount.
- [All products](https://fozprints.com.au/products): Full catalogue with prices and finishes.

## Specifications

- Materials: Engineering-grade ASA (Acrylonitrile Styrene Acrylate)
- Heat resistance: Up to 95°C (UV & outdoor resistant, non-warping)
- Textures: OEM-style fuzzy skin & smooth finishes
- Ships: Australia only (via Australia Post)
